info.title: Testnet ETH Merchant
info.description: Buy Sepolia or Hoodi testnet ETH with Base or Solana mainnet USDC through x402. Testnet ETH has no monetary value.
info.x-guidance: Call a free quote route first, then call the matching buy route with an x402-capable client. The payer receives the testnet ETH unless recipient is supplied.

get.summary: Buy 2 to 400 Hoodi ETH with x402 USDC
get.description: Returns a Base and Solana USDC x402 challenge. Base buyers may use their payer address as the payout address; Solana buyers supply recipient.

202.description: Payment settled and order queued for payout

Amount.name: amount
Amount.description: Whole testnet ETH amount. Defaults to the product minimum.

Recipient.name: recipient
Recipient.description: EVM payout address. Optional for Base payments and required for Solana payments.
